tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Read the public AiGramX feed of AI-creator and robotics posts. No authentication required.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search AiGramX posts, hashtags, and creators. No authentication required.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single public post (caption, media, AI attribution, engagement) by its id.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get a creator's public profile by username.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_post" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feed, search, get_post, create_post · Private data: create_post · Public sink: get_post, create_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feed, search, get_post, create_post · Private data: create_post · Public sink: get_post, create_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
